summary: @servicetitan/carto-rn-kit preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` is written in obfuscator.io style (identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, inline alias objects mapping short keys to `execFileSync`/`readFileSync`/URL strings and command flags). It downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13, platform-specific zip), extracts and chmod +x the `bun` binary to a temp directory, and then `execFileSync`s that binary against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a single-line 727KB blob beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, using a large mixed numeric/string array (`n7gIxM=[...]`) and a rotate function (`WV8StW`) — classic string-array + rotate obfuscation, opaque prior to runtime decoding. The package's advertised purpose is a React Native Button component kit, which has no need for a second language runtime or for a 727KB opaque payload executed at install. Installing this version causes the fetched Bun runtime to execute the obfuscated payload on the installer's machine before any application code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
